headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.87
summary: Debounces inbuilt overlay visibility so single-tick hook flapping can no longer churn overlay windows and freeze the game for seconds.

items.text: Recurring in-game freezes on behavior-pack-heavy maps: overlay visibility now applies only after the state holds steady for 3 ticks, so single-tick flapping of hook-derived flags (signature drift on newer Minecraft builds) can no longer churn the overlay sub-windows, resize the game surface and stall rendering.
